meta_description:
aditiraval on September 25, 2026: "For six years, I’ve travelled across Gujarat during the monsoon for Mari Najare Gujarat. But this time, Kathiawad showed me a side of Gujarat I hadn’t experienced quite like this before.

Crocodile spotting. Nature trails. Jamjir. Ambardi Safari Park. Devalia Safari Park. Kathiawadi food. Birding. Village life. And those lush monsoon landscapes that make Gir and Dhari feel completely different.

More than a journey through places, this was a journey through nature, people, culture and responsible travel.

Some of these experiences were thoughtfully curated and managed by Woods at Sasan, including the Jamjir experience, crocodile spotting, River Tale, the hilltop experience and more.

And our journey on the road continues with TATA.CARS, our Drive Partner consistently since September 2020. Six years of travelling through Gujarat together, and we truly value that association.

A big thank you to the local villagers, forest officers, guides and naturalists who shared their knowledge and helped us understand these places beyond what we see on a map.

Travel Cinematography: @uditbuch , @raj_rajput.official , @iamkuldi & @aditiraval 
Edited by: Kuldeepsinh Vaghela
Sound Design: Vatsal Patel | Legato Labz Sound
Produced by: Aditi Raval

Drive Partner: TATA Sierra @tata.cars.official 
Experience Partner: Woods at Sasan @woodsatsasan 

This travel video has been independently created to encourage responsible and sustainable local tourism. Please follow the instructions of forest officials, authorised guides and local authorities. Rules and permissions vary by destination.

Do not step out of vehicles where prohibited. Do not disturb wildlife or litter. Photography, professional filming and drone activity may require applicable permissions.

Copyright © Aditi Raval and Team 2026. All rights reserved.

#MariNajareGujarat #GujaratForest #AditiRaval #WoodsAtSasan #partnership".
